mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in low-rate periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 270) combined with a persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signals stagflation risk, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 270 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic momentum, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST and 60d returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in high-housing periods are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL rising more than 0.5 percentage points in a single month) signals heightened inflationary pressures, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 50k and RSAFS increases by > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by > 50k and RSAFS increases by > 0.5% in the past month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5 percentage points in a single month signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls > 0.5pp in 1 month.
